lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of horizontally-aligned high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly parallel rows, with increased spatial density observed in the region immediately posterior to the gill slits and increasing inter-blob distance toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like coordinate system, most visible in the central lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features situated on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and high shadow/low luminance on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately four high-luminance blobs localized within the lower-mid silhouette of the first dorsal fin.
